title: Nuclear Weapons and Weapons of Mass Destruction

flashcard_questions.q: Weapons which cause widespread, indiscriminate damage, including nuclear, chemical, and biological weapons.
Weapons that work by nuclear reaction, devastating huge areas and killing large numbers of people.
Having nuclear weapons with the aim of preventing other states from attacking, for fear of retaliation and mutually assured destruction.

flashcard_questions.a: A scenario in which both sides in a nuclear conflict would be completely destroyed, making nuclear war unwinnable.
flashcard_questions.q: What is meant by 'Mutually Assured Destruction'?

flashcard_questions.a: An ethical theory that judges actions by whether they produce the greatest happiness for the greatest number of people.
